Summary

Overall 7 years of Banking industry experience spread across Business Analysis, Quality Assurance and Banking.

Complete understanding of SDLC processes and Agile & Waterfall Methodologies. • Proficient in creating Business Requirement Document, Functional Requirement Document, Use Case specification Document, Workflows, Implementation guides, Functional Specification Document, and Requirement Traceability Matrix.

Expertise in creating User stories, UML diagrams, Wireframes, and Mockups using MS Visio, Lucidchart, Balsamiq, etc.

Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IMS, Ghaziabad.

Key Skills

Use Case • BRD |FRD| SRS • UML & Data flow modeling • Requirement Elicitation & Gathering • Rest API

Agile & Waterfall • Process Modelling • Gap Analysis

Tools

Microsoft Visio | Lucidchart | Balsamiq | JIRA | Confluence | MS Excel | MYSQL | MS Office

Professional Experience

Capgemini Technology India Pvt Ltd Role- Senior Consultant (Business Analyst)

15h May 2025 – Present

Requirement Elicitation and Gathering Requirements. • Drafting Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Requirement Document (FRD) • Following Agile methodology and creation of user stories. • Performing Gap analysis using AS-IS and TO-BE process. • Process modelling using UML on Windows Visio (Use cases, Sequence diagram, Activity diagram, Data Flow, Flow chart, etc.)

Following up with stakeholders for UAT Sign-off close observation till successful Go-live. • Making Sprint Planning for a project. • Detailed Business analysis, outline problem, opportunities and solution for business. • Compare current message formats (like SWIFT MT) with ISO 20022 standards to highlight differences. • Create Mapping legacy SWIFT MT messages to ISO 20022 MX formats. • • The project centers on the implementation of ISO 20022 messaging standards within Barclays UK’s Trade360 application, ensuring compliance with global payment modernization initiatives. Trade360 supports both SWIFT MT messages (MT101, MT103, MT202, etc.) and ISO 20022 MX messages (Pain.001, Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Camt.052, Camt.053, Camt.056, etc.), enabling seamless interoperability across payment schemes. As a Business Analyst, responsibilities include impact analysis across applications (GPP, Trade360, IMI, TMIL) and schemes (Fedwire, CHIPS, CHAPS), driving migration readiness, regulatory alignment, and operational efficiency.

ISO 20022 Migration with Trade360

Newgen Software Technologies, India

Role- Business Analyst

16th Apr, 2024

Requirement Elicitation and Gathering Requirements. • Drafting Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Requirement Document (FRD) • Following of Agile methodology and creation of user stories. • Performing Gap analysis using AS-IS and TO-BE process. • Process modelling using UML on Windows Visio (Use cases, Sequence diagram, Activity diagram, Data Flow, Flow chart, etc.)

Following up with stakeholders for UAT Sign-off close observation till successful Go-live. • Making Sprint Planning for a project. • Detailed Business analysis, outline problem, opportunities and solution for business. • The Payment Hub is capable of generating various MT messages such as MT 101, MT 102, MT 103, MT 202, MT 202 COV, MT 900, MT 910, MT 940, MT 942, MT 199, and MT 299. Additionally, it supports corresponding ISO 20022 MX messages, including Pain.001, Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Pacs.002, Pacs.004, Camt.052, Camt.053, and Camt.056.

The system is also integrated with the Core Banking system, Treasury, and the Central Bank Network, enabling it to read single and bulk message files. Each message is processed to create corresponding work items and is integrated with the Compliance application to ensure adherence to regulatory standards. ISO 20022 Payment Hub Implementation JNCB Bank

• The project delivers the end-to-end implementation of FBN Bank’s Payment Hub, enabling subsidiaries across multiple countries to adopt ISO 20022 standards for payments. The hub supports both SWIFT MT messages (MT101, MT103, MT202, etc.) and ISO 20022 MX messages (Pain.001, Pacs.008, Camt.053, etc.), ensuring interoperability and compliance with global payment modernization. Integrated with the Core Banking system, Treasury, and Central Bank Network, the solution processes single and bulk files, generates work items, and connects with the Compliance application to meet regulatory requirements. 30th Mar, 2022- 27th Mar, 2024

Worked with cross functional team during development, Integration Testing, Functional Testing, and UAT to deliver end-to-end solution.

Helped the team to understand the requirements during planning sessions for better estimation of user stories the team would commit to for the sprint.

Delivered other requirement documents like Use Case\Process Flow\Change Requests\SRS\ Requirement Traceability Matrix. Involved in creating wireframes and mockups for the system using Balsamiq.

• Verification\Validation of requirements to ensure they deliver business value by conducting various. • Having a thorough experience in UAT testing, writing test cases and executing test cases. • Have fair knowledge of SDLC, STLC and Bug Life Cycle. • Having a good knowledge to handle overall Banking project related to Trade Finance, Outward Remittances, Swift Messages and IS020022.

Basic understanding of ISO20022, MT/MX and SEPA. • HSBC Trade Portal & ISO 20022 Migration • The project delivers the Trade Portal solution for HSBC, enabling customers to submit and track Documentary Credit and Import/Export Collection transactions with attached documents. Production users can review submissions, verify customer credit limits, issue Letters of Credit, perform AML/compliance checks, and generate SWIFT messages aligned with international trade finance standards. The solution also integrates FX capabilities, allowing staff to book cross-currency deals during transaction processing.

From a migration perspective, the project ensures transition from legacy SWIFT MT messages (MT103, MT202, MT900, MT910, MT940, MT950) to their corresponding ISO 20022 MX formats (Pain.001, Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Pacs.002, Camt.052, Camt.053, Camt.056). This migration enhances interoperability, regulatory compliance, and future-proofs HSBC’s trade finance operations under the ISO 20022 framework.

BGSS, India Role- Deputy Manager

27th -Sep 2021 – 14th Mar, 2022

Responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of a project, making sure the resources are aware of deadlines and tasks that they are responsible. • Co-ordinate with developer and tester. • Meeting with prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, emphasizing product features and benefits

with focus on the value of the solution.

ICICI Bank, India Role- Deputy Manager (Business Analyst)

10th- APR-2019-27th Aug 2021

Requirement Gathering: Captured business needs through meetings (MoM) and discussions with senior Business Analysts.

Documentation: Prepared BRD, FRD, and SRS to formalize requirements and ensure clarity for IT and vendor teams. • Coordination: Acted as a bridge between UAT/OPS users, vendor Business Analysts, and IT teams, resolving queries and validating requirements.

Testing Support: Assisted in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm that system functionalities aligned with documented requirements.

Stakeholder Communication: Ensured smooth collaboration across business, operations, and technology teams during migration.

Trade Finance & NTS Migration • The project involved the migration and implementation of the new Trade Finance application (NTS) at ICICI Bank, designed to handle end-to-end cross-border remittances for advance payments, direct payments, and service payments. The initiative aimed to modernize trade finance operations, streamline remittance workflows, and ensure compliance with regulatory and operational standards.

Education

Post Graduate Diploma in Management

Mar 2019

B.Tech (CS)

Mar 2016
